name: FlatQuant

0.description: Quantized output int8, same shape as x

reference:
import torch

def run(x, kronecker_p1, kronecker_p2, clip_ratio=1.0):
    x_shape = x.shape
    x1 = x @ kronecker_p2
    x2 = kronecker_p1.to(torch.float32) @ x1.to(torch.float32)
    x2 = x2.to(torch.float16)
    x2 = x2.flatten(-2, -1)
    qscale = torch.abs(x2).max(dim=-1, keepdim=True)[0].to(torch.float32)
    ratio = 7.0 / clip_ratio
    qscale2 = ratio / qscale
    out = x2 * qscale2.to(torch.float16)
    out = torch.clamp(out, -8, 7)
    out = torch.round(out).to(torch.int8).reshape(x_shape)
    quant_scale = torch.flatten(qscale / ratio)
    return out, quant_scale
description: Fused Kronecker transformation and per-channel INT4 quantization. Steps: (1) Kronecker transform x @ p2, then p1 @ result, (2) per-channel absmax quantization, (3) clamp/round to int8. Returns (quantized_output int8, quant_scale float). clip_ratio controls quantization range.
